verification_instructions: For each changed .dart file: (1) confirm braces {} and parens () balance; (2) grep to confirm NO server-side query filter (.eq/.neq/.filter) on payout_model anywhere in lib/; (3) grep to confirm NO newly-added column name (rules, demo_asset_type, demo_asset_url) appears inside any .select('...') projection string - new columns must be read from SELECT * result maps only; (4) confirm demo-asset upload reuses R2StorageService.uploadFile like submit_task_screen.dart; (5) confirm every new optional detail section is wrapped in an `if (value isNotEmpty)` guard; (6) confirm dark-mode-safe colors (AppColors.dark* branches on Theme brightness).
setup_instructions: No setup runnable in sandbox. Edits are made directly in the working tree on branch Rexo-Kotlin. The orchestrator commits and pushes. DB changes ship as a .sql file under supabase/ that the USER runs manually in the Supabase SQL editor.
environment_constraints: Flutter/Dart NOT installed; network INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (cannot reach live Supabase DB or pull packages). Verify by reading + grep + brace/paren balance only. NEVER create a branch or PR. Only edit the working tree on branch Rexo-Kotlin.
contribution_requirements: CRITICAL data-model constraints (verified, do NOT relitigate): (a) PostgREST schema cache will NOT serve newly-created tables or newly-added columns REFERENCED BY NAME in a query filter or .select() projection (PGRST205/PGRST204/42703). It DOES serve legacy public.campaigns via SELECT *. (b) Jobs are rows in public.campaigns tagged payout_model='job'; filtering to jobs is done CLIENT-SIDE in Dart, never with a server-side .eq on payout_model. (c) New columns must be added by ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS on the EXISTING public.campaigns table only. (d) New columns must be WRITTEN as insert/update VALUES (safe) and READ from the SELECT * result map (never named in a .select projection or query filter).

Reusable widgets lib/core/widgets/ (PremiumButton, PremiumTextField with .multiline named ctor, PremiumAppBar, ImageUploadField, PremiumCard, EmptyState). Icons via lib/core/icons/app_icons.dart (Iconsax.*). R2 upload: R2StorageService.uploadFile(path, bytes, contentType) -> public URL. File/media picking + R2 upload reference implementation is lib/features/jobs/screens/submit_task_screen.dart (segmented control None/Link/Photo/PDF/Video, image_picker pickImage/pickVideo, Uuid filename, _getContentType map). Segmented selector widget pattern: _SubmissionTypeSelector in submit_task_screen.dart.
